title_en: Ibn Taymiyya's Stance on the Hadith That God Created Adam in His Image (Part 3)
description_en: Ibn Taymiyya's stance on the hadith that God created Adam in his image, Part 3. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Part three of the analysis concerning Ibn Taymiyya's views on the hadith of creating Adam in the divine image.
